en: Hetu-hetusampayuttaduka (The Dyad of Root and Root-Associated)
Dependent on a state that is both a root and associated with a root, there arises a state that is neither a root nor dissociated from a root, by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is both a root and associated with a root, there arises a state that is dissociated from a root but not a non-root, by way of root-condition. Dependent on a state that is both a root and associated with a root...
Dependent on states that are both root-conditions and dissociated from roots, as well as states that are dissociated from roots but not root-conditions,
[other] states arise by way of the root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is associated with roots but is not itself a root, [other] states that are dissociated from roots and are not root-conditions arise.

A state arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on a state that is associated with roots but is not itself a root, there arises a state that is both not a root and dissociated from roots, by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is associated with roots but is not itself a root, there arises a state that is both not a root and dissociated from roots, and [a state] that is dissociated from roots but not a root, by way of root-condition.
And states arise by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is both a root and associated with a root, as well as a state that is associated with a root but not itself a root, there arises a state that is neither a root nor dissociated from a root, by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is both a root and associated with a root...
Dependent on a state that is both associated with a root and not itself a root,
there arises a state that is both dissociated from roots and not itself a root, by way of the root condition. Dependent on a state that is both a root and associated with a root,

and [dependent on] a state that is both associated with a root and not itself a root, there arises a state that is both a non-root and dissociated from roots, and [a state] that is both dissociated from roots and not itself a root.
And phenomena arise with a cause as a condition through the cause-condition. (Abbreviated.
Nine [answers] for the cause; ... pe ... nine for non-disappearance. (The "Co-arising" section and the "Investigation" section are also to be expanded in detail.)
